Mixed greens salad on a square plate (about 26 cm), with arugula, cherry tomatoes, olives, red onion, cucumber, feta and dressing. I estimate about 150 g of food. Greens are around 60 g, and the vegetables, olives and feta make up the rest. The dressing probably adds 80–100 kcal and the feta and olives about 50 kcal, for roughly 180 kcal in total.
